_about.armor: the game's five armour tables (BOOT.BIN, pointer table at file 0x176b48; 0x28-byte records): `m`/`f` the piece each gender draws (record +0 / +2 model -> <g>_<hair|body|arm|wst|reg><model>), `wear` record +4 (m, f, b Blademaster, g Gunner), `rar` +5 + 1, `col` +0x13 the piece's colour mode (0 none, 1 a fixed grey, 2 S-Series, 3 X/Z-Series; pieces[].dyeMat is the material the game colours). Names: the game's English text. Model 0 is the clothing drawn under an empty slot.
_about.chars: 32 faces and 27 hairstyles per gender (f_face / f_head files).
_about.inner: the clothing drawn in an EMPTY legs / chest / arms slot (0x088D6388): inner[g][slot][clothing x 4 + tone[g][face]] (BOOT s16 tables 0x089B6784 legs, 0x089B680C chest, 0x089B6894 arms; the tone u8 tables 0x089B66BC male / 0x089B66DC female by face, 0x08851FEC); clothing = the character's CLOTHING choice (player +0x4B5, 0-7). An empty waist draws record 0's model; an empty head the hairstyle.
_about.rigs: the 21-bone player rig of each gender; every piece is skinned to it.
_about.poses: the hunter's motions: f0081 (Common) and f3397-f3407 (one per weapon class, in the game's class order, BOOT.BIN u16 table at 0x1b4c18), on the rig, clips named '<set>:<slot>' as the game stores them (no names in the data); 60 fps (the game steps a motion 2 frames per 30 Hz update).
